items.title: Eurobarometer survey shows overwhelming public support for European agriculture and EU support for farmers and rural areas
items.dek: European Commission Press release Brussels, 22 Sep 2026 According to the latest Eurobarometer survey, 95% of Europeans consider agriculture and rural areas important for Europe's future, while 93% say that securing a stable food supply for the EU is crucial.
